content: वृषभः [वृष्-अभच् किच्च <ls>Uṇ. 3. 122</ls>] .²1 A bull. .²2 Any male animal. .²3 Anything best or eminent of its class (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); द्विजवृषभः <ls>Ratn. 1. 5</ls>; किं नास्ति त्वयि सत्यमात्यवृषभे यस्मिन् करोमि स्पृहाम् <ls n="Ratn.">4. 20</ls>. .²4 The sign {%Taurus%} of the zodiac. .²5 A kind of drug; <ab>cf.</ab> ऋषभ. .²6 An elephantʼs ear. .²7 The orifice or hollow of the ear. .²8 Justice (धर्म personified); <ls>Mb. 12. 43. 8</ls>. .{@-भा@} <ab>N.</ab> of the three lunar mansions (<ab>viz.</ab> of मघा, पूर्व-फल्गुनी, and उत्तर-फल्गुनी).
